'''Bryn Shale''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She once claimed she would steal the ''[[Dawn of Light]]'', a sculpture made by the famous [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Kasa Xanter]] from [[Aurea]] during its exposition at the [[Vorheim Gallery]].
